scope_note: Overall-status regression on the bundled fixture. No human verifications are supplied, so READY is unreachable and no false-READY rate is reported. The false-PENDING_VERIFICATION count is implied by the exact-status match on fixtures written alongside the extractor, so it is a regression invariant, not a safety estimate. A correct overall status can hide a wrong requirement; requirement-level results are in docs/evaluation/requirement_level_baseline.md.
